programmes.t: The Re-Inventors S2 - "Chinese Rockets"
programmes.d: Rebuilding a 700-year-old multi-stage weapon brings multiple problems to Matt and Jeremy.

programmes.t: The Re-Inventors S2 - "Human Propulsion"
programmes.d: Trisk skis can move a person quickly in the snow, but will he survive it?

programmes.t: Made in Britain S1 - "Whitaker's Chocolates and Heck! Sausages"
programmes.d: Lord Prescott visits Whitaker’s chocolate factory to explore large-scale chocolate making, from factory lines to expert tasting and the company’s rich history. He then heads to HECK! Sausages in North Yorkshire, where he attempts to create his own custom recipe—the Hull banger.

programmes.t: Made in Britain S1 - "Wensleydale Cheese and Mowbray Pork Pies"
programmes.d: At the Wensleydale Creamery, Lord Prescott joins master cheesemakers to follow the production of the famous Yorkshire Wensleydale cheese, learning the art of cheese-tasting along the way. His next stop is Mowbray Pork Pies, where he experiences the high-speed world of pie production.

programmes.t: Made in Britain S1 - "Lea and Perrins Worcestershire Sauce and Soreen's Malt Loaf"
programmes.d: Exploring the historic Lea & Perrins factory, Lord Prescott uncovers the story behind its legendary Worcestershire sauce, made since 1837. He then heads to Manchester to the Soreen factory, home of the beloved malt loaf, where he joins the production line and experiments with creating a new flavour.

programmes.t: Made in Britain S1 - "Ambrosia's desserts and Young's battered fish"
programmes.d: To discover how his favourite meal—fish supper followed by rice pudding—is made, Lord Prescott visits the Ambrosia factory in Devon to explore the production of classic British desserts. Returning north to Grimsby, he heads to the Young's factory to learn about their famous fish pie.

programmes.t: Wild And Alive S1 - "Place of Hope"
programmes.d: The seasons at De Hoop Nature Reserve drive a remarkable recovery for five iconic species, from the arrival of whales to the intense Bontebok rut.

programmes.t: The Best Of Worlds: Life At Its Alpine Limits
programmes.d: The Alps are home to plants and animals that owe their success to an amazing capacity to live in conditions that for other species, would be barely tolerable. For them however, this is everyday life.

programmes.t: Green Tree Ants: Friend Or Foe?
programmes.d: All over the tropics of Australia and Asia, local armies of 500,000 soldiers are on standby. They are the terrifyingly organised, frighteningly violent, green tree ants. We investigate their rise to power.

programmes.t: Last Lion Of Liuwa
programmes.d: A haunting roar echoes across the Liuwa Plain. There is no answer, there hasn't been for years. She has no pride, no support - she alone must safeguard her own survival. She is Lady Liuwa, the Last Lioness.

programmes.t: Animal Ambulance S1 - "Big Dogs and Tiny Troubles"
programmes.d: Drivers Sonia and Angela rescue a giant dog with a puzzling problem, while vets Cristina and Lawrence treat a sad guinea pig and an orphan kitten.

programmes.t: Animal Ambulance S1 - "The Cat, the Hound and the Snake"
programmes.d: A chubby cat, a snake, a greyhound in surgery, and playful kittens keep the team busy in another day of unique and heartwarming animal care.

programmes.t: Animal Ambulance S1 - "The Old, the Bold and the Newborn"
programmes.d: A 17-year-old cat, a bulldog with a mystery swelling, newborn pups, and a mischievous puppy test the Blue Cross team’s skill and compassion.

programmes.t: Animal Ambulance S1 - "Accidents, Surgeries and Fearful Friends"
programmes.d: The team springs into action for a a puppy hit by car, Westie's unusual surgery and a Staffordshire that fears fireworks.

programmes.t: Borneo's Pygmy Elephants
programmes.d: Borneo’s diminutive pygmy forest elephants were always thought to be a feral population derived from domesticated Asian elephants. Now, though, DNA testing has confirmed that they are a unique subspecies who’ve lived on Borneo for at least 300,000 years.

programmes.t: Camp Raiders
programmes.d: Meet the 'Trash Can Clan' doing their daily round of the dustbins in South Africa's most famour national park, the Kruger.

programmes.t: Quolls: Fast & Furious
programmes.d: Explore the life and habits of the elusive northern subspecies of the spotted-tailed quoll. Come with us on a journey into the personal life of this beautiful long-lost cousin of the Tasmanian tiger.

programmes.t: Frontier Vets S1 - "Tough Day at the Office"
programmes.d: The vets get situated in their dormitory accommodations. Dr. Greg deliberately pairs them according to their differences. Vets need to learn to work with colleagues and clients different from themselves.

programmes.t: Wildlife Heroes S1 - "Lydia Moecklinghoff"
programmes.d: Lydia Möcklinghoff, a renowned anteater researcher, has dedicated her life to the protection and study of these fascinating creatures.

programmes.t: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1 - "Stadiums: Stunning Arenas"
programmes.d: Sports stadiums are widely considered architectural treasures, on par with shrines, cathedrals and other important monuments.

programmes.t: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1 - "Memorials and Monuments: Built in Honor"
programmes.d: Monuments like the Great Sphinx, Hagia Sophia and Statue of Liberty are valued for their historical, religious and national significance.

programmes.t: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1 - "City Squares: Amazing and Never Still"
programmes.d: City squares have distinctive characters and often play a major role in enriching and enhancing the cultures of their cities.

programmes.t: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1 - "Parks and Gardens: Paradise Created by Humans"
programmes.d: Buildings with eccentric and unorthodox designs often have methods behind their madness, and serve to remind us of moments in history.

programmes.t: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1 - "Playful Design: Feast for the Eyes"
programmes.d: Buildings with eccentric and unorthodox designs often have methods behind their madness, and serve to remind us of moments in history.

programmes.t: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1 - "Theatres and Opera Houses: Unforgettable Experiences"
programmes.d: Theaters and opera houses are wonders of stage technology, as well as exquisite masterpieces of modern or historic architecture.

programmes.t: Bright Now S1 - "Message From Space?"
programmes.d: Deep in the mountains of West Virginia, the Green Bank Observatory has been receiving a mysterious signal from deep space. Could this be message from an advanced civilization, or is it a much stranger and violent occurrence?

programmes.t: Bright Now S1 - "African Animal Rescue"
programmes.d: The staff of South Africa's Manyoni Private Game Reserve passionately care for some of the world's most exotic and endangered wild animals. From treating elephant foot infections to testing cheetahs for tuberculosis, they never know what to expect.

programmes.t: Xploration Outer Space S3 - "What Makes a Planet?"
programmes.d: Host Emily Calandrelli looks at many objects that, regardless of definition, look like new and fascinating planets.

programmes.t: Xploration Outer Space S3 - "A Space Station for All"
programmes.d: Host Emily Calandrelli explores what kind of experiments are being conducted on the International Space Station that will benefit humans on earth.

programmes.t: Xploration Outer Space S3 - "Mars vs. the Moon"
programmes.d: Host Emily Calandrelli investigates this dilemma which will determine our space-faring future.

programmes.t: Xploration Outer Space S4 - "Landing on Mars"
programmes.d: Host Emily Calandrelli looks at the varied and ingenious methods used to land spacecraft on the red planet, starting with Pathfinder in 1997.

programmes.t: Secrets of the Factories S1 - "Secrets of Kellogg's Cereals"
programmes.d: In Kellogg’s first factory in Europe, built in the 1930s in Trafford Park, Manchester, we meet the people who flake the corn and puff the rice, the tasters who test, and the robots and hi-tech machines that help keep the boxes rolling out day and night.
